summary: Russia launched a massive combined ballistic missile and drone strike targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions overnight, with three ballistic missiles hitting the Kyiv area including the northern bridge and Epicentr mall on Obolon. Ukrainian air defense engaged numerous Shahed/Geran-5 drones across at least ten oblasts while ballistic missile threats persisted from Kursk and Voronezh directions. Meanwhile, Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk oblast as ceasefire talks stalled with Moscow rejecting Kyiv's proposal.
key_points: Three ballistic missiles struck Kyiv region: two likely KN-23 near Kaharlyk/Bila Tserkva, one Iskander-M near Irpin/Bucha/Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78141)
Three impacts reported on Kyiv's northern bridge during attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78151)
Strike hit Epicentr mall in Kyiv's Obolon district. (Source: @UkraineNow/85250)
Nationwide drone wave: Shahed/Geran-5 drones targeted Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78117)
Ballistic missile threat active from Kursk and Voronezh directions per monitoring channels. (Source: @kpszsu/95287)
Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk oblast per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993)
Zelensky stated Russia rejected ceasefire proposal; negotiations continue in Abu Dhabi format with US involvement. (Source: @UkraineNow/85246)
Canada allocating CAD 6 billion over ten years to CSIS to counter Russian influence operations targeting Ukraine support. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23995)

points: Air defense engaged massive combined attack: ballistic missiles (Iskander-M, KN-23) and Shahed/Geran-5 drones across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk regions overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78141, @mon1tor_ua/78117)
Three ballistic missile impacts confirmed on Kyiv's northern bridge; strike also hit Epicentr shopping mall in Obolon district causing damage. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78151, @UkraineNow/85250)

President Zelensky confirmed Russia rejected Ukrainian ceasefire proposal; negotiations continue in trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia format in Abu Dhabi with separate European partners meeting planned. (Source: @UkraineNow/85246, @UkraineNow/85237)
Kyiv authorities preparing emergency river crossing via boats on Dnipro River for civilians during attacks per MP Kreidenko. (Source: @UkraineNow/85245)
Air raid alerts sounded nationwide from 00:54 to 02:00 local time covering all regions as missile and drone threats persisted. (Source: @eRadarrua/130156, @eRadarrua/130185)

Launched three ballistic missiles toward Kyiv region from Poltava oblast direction: two probable KN-23 impacting near Kaharlyk/Bila Tserkva, one Iskander-M near Irpin/Bucha/Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78141)

Deployed multiple Shahed/Geran-5 drone groups from Black Sea waters targeting Odesa, Mykolaiv (Ochakiv, Chornomorske), and from Bryansk, Kursk, Crimea toward Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk. (Source: @kpszsu/95252, @kpszsu/95270, @kpszsu/95292, @eRadarrua/130153, @kpszsu/95247)
Ballistic missile launch platforms active in Kursk and Voronezh oblasts of Russia per threat alerts. (Source: @kpszsu/95287, @kpszsu/95294)
Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk oblast per frontline mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993)
Moscow rejected Ukrainian ceasefire proposal per Zelensky; Russian delegation participating in Abu Dhabi talks with US mediators. (Source: @UkraineNow/85246, @UkraineNow/85240)
Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk oblast per DeepState map update indicating continued pressure on Ukrainian defensive lines. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23993)
Reactive drone group from Donetsk oblast moving toward Pokrovsk area in Dnipropetrovsk oblast per monitoring. (Source: @kpszsu/95302)
Drone group heading toward Pavlohrad from east in Dnipropetrovsk oblast. (Source: @kpszsu/95269)

Multiple drone incursions from Bryansk oblast (Russia) into Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts: Chernihiv sector saw drones bypassing Mykhailo-Kotsiubynske, Slavutych, Olyshivka; Sumy sector targeted from Kursk. Geran-5 missile/drone strikes on Zhytomyr city and Korosten district reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78119, @mon1tor_ua/78117)

Drone groups from Black Sea targeting Odesa oblast: multiple reactive drones toward Zatoka, Chornomorske, Podilsk from north; two drones from Crimea toward Odesa. (Source: @kpszsu/95252, @kpszsu/95270, @kpszsu/95292, @eRadarrua/130155, @eRadarrua/130153)
